description: This file defines the SugarRestService class, which provides a base class for RESTful web services in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for registering functions, handling requests, and managing REST implementations related to SugarCRM's web services architecture.

classes.name: SugarRestService
classes.description: A base class for REST services in SuiteCRM, handling registration of functions, response types, and server communication logic.

methods.name: _getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the class name for the specified response/input type, defaulting to 'SugarRest' if not found.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the REST service with the provided URL, setting up input/output type handlers.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Placeholder method for registering data types (empty implementation).

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers a PHP function to be exposed via the REST API, along with its input and output specifications.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles an incoming request, generates a response using the appropriate response class, and sends it back to the client.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Placeholder method for registering multiple functions at once (empty implementation).

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Returns the name of the implementation class registered for this service.

methods.name: getRegisteredClass
methods.description: Returns the name of the registry class.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Registers the implementation class for the REST service and creates instances of the server and implementation.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets an error state in the server using a SoapError object.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the server object handling the REST request.
